sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:6904
Court No. - 76
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 8418 of 2023
Applicant :- Meenu Alias Pushpendra Kumar And

Another
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Bhuvnesh Kumar Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1. Supplementary affidavit filed today on behalf of the informant is taken on record.

2. Sri Rajeev Dhar Dwivedi, learned Aga, for the State, apprised the Court that he has received the
instructions, therefore, the instant anticipatory bail application may be finally disposed off.
3. Heard Sri Bhuvnesh Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Rajeev Dhar Dwivedi, learned AGA, for the State.

4. The instant anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicants with the prayer to release them on anticipatory bail in FIR/Case Crime No.286 of 2017, under Sections 420 and 272 IPC and Sections 60 and 72 Excise Act, Police Station Noorpur, District Bijnor till the conclusion of trial.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 5. According to the FIR, applicants along with one another indulged in selling liquor in the State of U.P. illegally.

6. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that entire allegation made against the applicants are totally false and applicants did not indulge in any illegal activities of selling of illegal liquor in the State of U.P.
7.

He further submits that during investigation when applicants challenged the FIR of the present case before this Court in Criminal Misc.Writ Petition No. 15363 of 2017 then this Court after considering the entire facts of the case on 2.8.2017 was pleased to stay the arrests of the applicants till the submission of police report under Section 173(2) Cr.P.C.
8.
He further submits that now after investigation charge sheet has been submitted against the applicants.

He next submits that however charge sheet was filed against the applicants in the year 2017 but applicants were not aware about the same as no summons were ever served upon them and when the court concerned started taking coercive measures against the applicants then they applied for anticipatory bail before the court concerned but their application was dismissed.

9. He further submits that as applicants were protected by Division Bench of this Court during investigation and they fully cooperated with the investigation, therefore, considering the observations of the Apex Court in the case of Md. Asfak Alam Vs. State of Jharkhand and another,
2023 8 SCC 632, applicants may be enlarged on anticipatory bail till the conclusion of the trial.

entities.text:
Md. Asfak Alam Vs. State of Jharkhand and another,
2023 8 SCC 632
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 10. He further submits that now charge sheet has been filed and applicants are having apprehension if they will appear before the court concerned then they will be sent to Jail.

11. He further submits that applicant no.1 is not having any previous criminal history to his credit but applicant no.2 is having criminal history of a single case and his criminal history has been explained in the supplementary affidavit filed in support of the instant anticipatory bail application.
12. Per contra, learned AGA although opposed the prayerfor anticipatory bail but could not dispute argument on facts advanced by the learned counsel for the applicants.
13. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

14. Considering the fact that Division Bench of this Court during investigation was pleased to stay the arrest of the applicants and applicant no.1 is not having any previous criminal history and criminal history of a single case of applicant no.2 has been explained in the supplementary affidavit filed in support of the instant anticipatory bail application and charge sheet was not filed under Section 272 IPC, in my view, applicants are entitled to be released on anticipatory bail till the conclusion of trial.
15. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail anticipatory application is allowed.

sentences.text:
In the event of arrest of the applicants-Meenu alias Pushpendra Kumar and Kalyan Dutt Sharma involved in the aforesaid case crime number, shall be released on bail till the conclusion of the trial on furnishing a personal bond with two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Presiding Officer/Court concerned with the conditions:-
(i) that the applicants shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
17. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall have the liberty to cancel the bail granted to the applicants.

18. It is made clear that the observations made in granting anticipatory bail to the applicants shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.
